claim: The renderer's GetFont(family, size, bold) (vtable 0x140cc30 slot 0x220 -> 0x116cbb0) rounds the size down to even, clamps it to 6..32 and opens font/<family>_[b_]<n>.cuf, so the list name Frontend 38 opens frontend_32.cuf and no size above 32 is ever opened by it
notes: static RE (run 2026-11-03_j37_static): the clamp is unconditional at 0x116cc24; open until the PC file survey shows frontend_32.cuf opened and frontend_38.cuf not (uiscale/runs/2026-11-03_j37_static/pc_plan.md). If it holds, J66's 2x pack draws every Frontend 38 text with the vanilla frontend_32
